summary: Retain runtime for reportValidity because interactive validation can invoke user-agent UI and focus behavior.

target.notes: Runtime performs interactive constraint validation, invalid event dispatch, and user-agent reporting/focus behavior.

caveats: A pure boolean validation helper cannot reproduce validation bubbles/focus/reporting.

tests.name: invalid form returns false and may report UI
tests.input: const f=document.createElement('form'); const i=document.createElement('input'); i.required=true; f.append(i); console.log(f.reportValidity());
tests.expected_behavior: prints false and user agent may present validation UI
